## Notation

- Namespaced ID form: `J-00N/<local-id>` or `SUMMARY/<local-id>`.
- Cross-file interactions, summary deltas, and ambiguity/conflict registers keep local IDs under their ledger namespace (e.g. `J-005/IX-003`, `J-008/SD-J16-001`).
- Kind tags: `[SRC]` source explicit, `[IX]` cross-source interaction, `[SD]` summary delta, `[AC]` ambiguity/conflict, `[INF]` inference (not a requirement).
- `SURFACE` marks user-facing windows, panels, commands, CLI verbs, flags, status displays, notifications (feeds dashboard DESIGN.md).
- Anchor form: `(ledger-file:L<line>)` points at the deep-ledger or summary definition line.

#### Bounded inferences (not source assertions) (3)

- **J-001/DJ001-I-001** [INF] (DEEP-J-001.discovery.md:L387 | unit=Bounded inferences (not source assertions)): [I|integration] Because J-28's T7 and J-76's local recipe observe the same compaction boundary through H-50, their implementation should expose one authoritative transition identity so token-growth proof and rebuilt-context proof cannot describe different compactions. This follows from DJ001-28-014/DJ001-28-043 and DJ001-76-006/DJ001-76-012; neither source explicitly mandates a shared identifier.
- **J-001/DJ001-I-002** [INF] (DEEP-J-001.discovery.md:L388 | unit=Bounded inferences (not source assertions)): [I|governance] Once J-43 conditional routing ships, implementation work for J-66/J-90 and any later voice/memory gate changes should be scanned by the doctrine floor because those tasks ship or audit features/gates.
